how do you spell vacuum | how to spell vacuum | spelling of vacuum | is it vaccum or vacuum | is vaccum spelled right => The word "vacuum" is spelled V-A-C-U-U-M. Tip: One c, two u's.
how do you spell vegetable | how to spell vegetable | spelling of vegetable | is it vegtable or vegetable | is vegtable spelled right => The word "vegetable" is spelled V-E-G-E-T-A-B-L-E. Tip: Say the e: veg-e-ta-ble.
how do you spell villain | how to spell villain | spelling of villain | is it villian or villain | is villian spelled right => The word "villain" is spelled V-I-L-L-A-I-N. Tip: It ends in -ain, like a villain wants to gain.
how do you spell wednesday | how to spell wednesday | spelling of wednesday | is it wensday or wednesday | is wensday spelled right => The word "Wednesday" is spelled W-E-D-N-E-S-D-A-Y. Tip: Say it like Wed-nes-day to remember the d.
how do you spell weird | how to spell weird | spelling of weird | is it wierd or weird | is wierd spelled right => The word "weird" is spelled W-E-I-R-D. Tip: It breaks the rule: weird is weird.
how do you spell yacht | how to spell yacht | spelling of yacht | is it yatch or yacht | is yatch spelled right => The word "yacht" is spelled Y-A-C-H-T. Tip: y-a-c-h-t, with a silent ch.
